capabilities: Render a book card from an ISBN written in a code block
Fetch book cover images from OpenBD
Display bibliography fields (title, author, publisher, publication date)
extras: Uses the network: every card fetches data from the OpenBD API, so rendering requires an internet connection. README is minimal, with usage shown only as a code example.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display book cover images and publication details from an ISBN inside a note.
summary: Book card renderer that fetches a book's cover and bibliography (title, author, publisher, date) from OpenBD when you write its ISBN in a code block.
